items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 27:1
items.html:
Judgments
In the second restriction, where the bottom Hey was included in the first Hey, two phases of judgments were made: the first is the first Hey that was included from the judgments of the bottom Hey, which is the phase of soft judgment. The second is the bottom Hey that is included from the first Hey in place of the bottom Hey, which is hard judgment, meaning the strong judgments of phase four itself. (p. 490, Item 7)
